# kiln v0.9.0

## Binaries
- The deprecated `kilnd` binary is removed (SR-66); use `kiln`. The release archives contain only `kiln`.

## Platforms
No x86_64-apple-darwin (Intel macOS) assets from this release on. Intel Mac users: build from source (`cargo install --locked --git https://github.com/pulseengine/kiln --tag v0.9.0 kilnd`).
